name: forager
description: Forager: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes across free LLM tiers on Cloudflare Workers

PROXY_API_KEY.description: Your router password. Clients send it as `Authorization: Bearer …` and you paste it into the dashboard. Use a long random string, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`, and keep a copy in your password manager.

KEYSTORE_SECRET.description: Encrypts the provider API keys you add in the dashboard. Any random string of **16+ characters** (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`). If you change it later, keys added in the dashboard must be re-added.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Name of the Cloudflare AI Gateway to log requests through. Optional: if it doesn't exist, Forager calls providers directly.

MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: How many provider/model attempts one request may make before giving up.

UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Milliseconds to wait for a provider to start answering (slow providers have their own, longer limits).

TRACKER.description: Durable Object that tracks free-quota usage per cycle and stores encrypted provider keys.

AI.description: Workers AI binding, used only to find your account ID for AI Gateway URLs.
